retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
BUSINESS EMAIL COMPROMISE

DESCRIPTION:
Business Email Compromise (BEC) is a targeted attack where adversaries impersonate executives, vendors, legal teams, or finance personnel to manipulate victims into transferring money or sensitive information.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1586 | Compromise Accounts

INDICATORS:
- Executive impersonation
- Fake invoice requests
- Vendor banking detail changes
- Urgent payment requests
- Newly created mailbox forwarding rules

DETECTION RULES:
- Suspicious forwarding rules
- Unusual mailbox logins
- Executive impersonation alerts

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Corporate email
- Finance systems
- Vendor communication channels
title: BUSINESS EMAIL COMPROMISE
